audience: email marketers who manage subscribers and lists in Robly

useCases.title: Check if a person is subscribed and on which lists
useCases.text: The AI finds a contact by email or member id and reads status, subscription date, sign-up source and lists, and checks membership of one list.

useCases.title: See who joined recently and on which lists
useCases.text: The AI lists contacts filtered by status, list or last-updated time, with the lists of each contact. You see new sign-ups.

useCases.title: Subscribe a contact to a list
useCases.text: The AI adds a new subscribed contact with data fields, or puts an existing contact on a list. Robly may send a confirmation or welcome email.

useCases.title: Update a contact or take it off a list
useCases.text: The AI changes a contact's data fields or list memberships, or removes the contact from one list. The contact itself is kept.

useCases.title: Create or rename a list
useCases.text: The AI creates a new empty list or renames one. It checks the existing lists first, as Robly does not say if a name already exists.

useCases.title: Unsubscribe a contact who asked to stop
useCases.text: The AI unsubscribes a contact so Robly stops emailing it. The API cannot undo this, and the contact can only return through a sign-up form.
